reviewScope: Independent source review only, not an external security audit or execution qualification.

v1Findings.evidence: Public fresh/recovery constructors receive Proof by value; apply receives Plan by value. Delegated recovery proof pointer refers only to the owned public parameter. Both token optionals are copied before callbacks.
v1Findings.originalExplanationCorrection: Claim of implicit public copy assignment was inaccurate: user-declared move constructor deletes implicit copy assignment. Concrete mutable underlying getter-reference / object reconstruction exposure motivated ownership repair.

invariantsReviewed.name: owned-full-transition-proof
invariantsReviewed.result: Genesis/pre/wire/rules copied before callback; full proposer signature/domain and production signed transition; complete post-state/execution/account/receipt equality; no validator count constant.

invariantsReviewed.name: raw-cas-preservation
invariantsReviewed.result: Dedicated publisher retains exact raw checkpoint string, digest, immutable store, pending operations and caches; uses empty suffix at current head, null retention and no blobs.

invariantsReviewed.name: namespace-and-coupling
invariantsReviewed.result: Requires owner-bound beacon PRIMARY, exact linked checkpoint digest/tip, no certified tip, separately namespaced recovery WITNESS.

invariantsReviewed.name: two-external-next-pins
invariantsReviewed.result: Plan exposes predicted PRIMARY sequence+1 with unchanged snapshot digest and independent WITNESS intent token. Typed recovery requires both caller pins, exact raw snapshot and only previous/next PRIMARY disposition.

invariantsReviewed.name: strict-archive-index
invariantsReviewed.result: Existing exact payload requires slot-index present and empty; absent payload requires no slot-index. No repair or replacement of conflicts.

invariantsReviewed.name: witness-first-failure-boundary
invariantsReviewed.result: Publication allocated and callbacks resolved before witness write; witness then synchronous coupled PRIMARY CAS; uncertain error latches unavailable; no callback between PRIMARY success and atomic publication.

invariantsReviewed.name: typed-recovery-not-generic
invariantsReviewed.result: Distinct intent format; generic recovery rejects archive-only same-digest authority; pending typed recovery independently reads/authenticates cold/fragment PRIMARY content and reuses exact held WITNESS; complete typed recovery makes no archive write.

invariantsReviewed.name: peer-admission-preserved
invariantsReviewed.result: Existing retained-root ACK semantics unchanged. No archive backfill or typed authority from peer ACK; unknown-root strict signature admission unchanged.
